name: change-radar
description: Track public information over time, retain evidence-linked facts, and compare changes from supported AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Long-running, evidence-linked change tracking / 长期、可追溯的变化追踪
interface.longDescription: Create long-running monitoring topics, inspect evidence-linked facts, and compare change over time from an Agent sidebar. 长期追踪公开信息，在 Agent 侧栏中查看可追溯事实、趋势与时期对比。
defaultPrompt: Open Change Radar and help me create a long-running monitoring topic. / 打开变更雷达，帮我创建一个长期追踪专题。
Show me the latest evidence-linked changes in my tracked topics. / 查看我的追踪专题中最近出现的可追溯变化。
Compare this topic across two time periods without treating missing data as zero. / 比较这个专题的两个时间段，不要把缺失数据当成零。
